name: hs_list_contacts
description: Browse all contacts in your HubSpot workspace. Returns contact IDs, names, emails, and properties. Paginate with limit and after parameters.

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return (default 10, max 100)

after.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

name: hs_get_contact
description: Fetch a contact's full profile by ID. Returns name, email, phone, company, and all custom properties.

name: hs_search_contacts
description: Search contacts by name, email, or custom properties. Use when you need to find specific people in your database.

name: hs_list_companies
description: Browse all companies in your HubSpot workspace. Returns company IDs, names, domains, and properties. Paginate with limit and after parameters.

limit.description: Maximum number of companies to return (default 10, max 100)

after.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

name: hs_get_company
description: Fetch a company's full profile by ID. Returns name, domain, industry, revenue, and all custom properties.

name: hs_list_deals
description: Browse all deals in your HubSpot workspace. Returns deal IDs, names, amounts, pipeline stages, and close dates. Paginate with limit and after parameters.

limit.description: Maximum number of deals to return (default 10, max 100)

after.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

name: hs_get_deal
description: Fetch a deal's full details by ID. Returns deal name, amount, stage, owner, and linked contacts and companies.
